name: list
description: List prompts, one per line as id, name, favorite mark, tags.

name: get
description: Show one prompt's fields. Exit 2 if the id does not exist.

name: copy
description: Copy a prompt's text to the clipboard. Exit 2 if the id does not exist.

name: add
usage: prompt-saver add --name NAME --text TEXT [--tags a,b] [--favorite] [--notes TEXT] [--color #rrggbb] --yes [--json]
description: Add a new prompt. Prints its new id.

name: edit
usage: prompt-saver edit <id> [--name NAME] [--text TEXT] [--tags a,b] [--favorite|--no-favorite] [--notes TEXT] [--color #rrggbb] --yes [--json]
description: Change one or more fields of an existing prompt.

name: delete
description: Move a prompt to the trash.

name: restore
description: Restore a prompt out of the trash.

name: tag list
description: List every tag in use with its prompt count.

name: tag add
description: Add one tag to one prompt.

name: tag remove
description: Remove one tag from one prompt.

name: view list
description: List every view.

name: view add
description: Add a new, empty view. Prints its new id.

name: view remove
description: Remove a view (refused for the last remaining one).

name: search
description: Case-insensitive search over name, text, notes and tags.

name: export
description: Write prompts to a file. --yes is only needed to overwrite an existing file.

name: import
description: Append prompts read from a file this app exported.

name: backup create
description: Snapshot the store now. Prints the new backup's name.

name: backup list
description: List existing backups, newest first.

name: backup restore
description: Replace the store with a backup. Always takes a safety snapshot first.

name: settings get
description: Read one setting. Exit 2 if the key is unknown.

name: settings set
description: Write one setting. The value is read as a whole number/decimal, true/false, or plain text, in that order, unless the key is one of the app's own fixed settings (theme, language, autostart, alwaysOnTop). Settings that grant access (folders, the vault, the backup password, the clipboard switches, the voice consent and the data folder lock) are refused; change them in the app.

name: version
description: Print the app name and version.
